## Observed (measured on `main` `e1423ad`, after #198)
`badf-engineering-verification` is `DESIGNED`. `EVIDENCE_RULES` (`badf_gate.py:1580-1592`) carries no rule for `independent-review`, `integration-test`, `contract-test` or `composed-tree-test`: a G08 object validates only against the generic `evidence.schema.json` core, so a review that is a bare `outcome: PASS` from an `agent` producer (`work/WP-2026-0010/evidence/G08/independent-review.json`) is indistinguishable from one that carries findings, non-coverage and a sealed target — the exact defect VER-I07/I08/I10 name. No typed G08 schema exists; no record carries a finding, a ballot, an independence block or a matrix row. BLD-B (#193) proved the additive pattern: `check_g07_binding` validates a typed `binding` when present and leaves generic objects admissible.

## Acceptance criteria (WP-2026-0103 / BADF-DEM-0090 — re-measured at filing: main e1423ad + every remote head + all issues/PRs; BARCHI-2 cleared, BARCHI-1 asked)
- **Four typed G08 schemas** `schemas/independent-review|integration-test|contract-test|composed-tree-test.schema.json`: the evidence core required verbatim (mirrors BLD-B), `evidence_type` pinned, a **closed** `binding` object per `references/g08-contract.md`:
  - `independent-review.binding`: `target {source_revision, target_base_sha, expected_content_tree, sealed_input_digest}` · `lens` · `reviewer {identity, reviewer_run_id, principal_type}` · `independence {reviewer_run_id, author_run_id, same_execution:false, sealed_input_digest, prior_findings_visible:false, author_reasoning_visible:false, cross_pass_communication_before_ballot:false, target_digest_equal:true}` · `findings[]` (the finding item below) · `non_coverage[] {surface, reason, impact}` · `completion {inspected_complete_diff, inspected_call_sites}` · `verdict ∈ docs/03's five`. **A typed review with `findings: []` and `non_coverage: []` is refused unless `completion.comprehensive_coverage_permitted_by` names the contract** (VER-I10/I11).
  - `integration-test.binding` / `composed-tree-test.binding`: `execution {runtime, command, working_directory, environment, toolchain, fixtures_epoch, seed, started_at, finished_at, exit_code, tests{total,passed,failed,skipped,quarantined}, output_digest}` · `target {source_revision, expected_content_tree}`; composed adds `composition {target_base_sha, merge_method, recorded_expected_content_tree, recomputed_content_tree, equal}` and `staleness`. `producer.type` on a typed observation is `controller|service|human` — **`agent` is refused** (VER-I08).
  - `contract-test.binding`: `surface` (the nine classes) · `contract_ref` · `result ∈ CONFORMANT|NONCONFORMANT|INDETERMINATE|NOT_APPLICABLE` · the mapping onto `outcome` enforced (`INDETERMINATE → BLOCKED`, never PASS) (VER-I14).
- **`schemas/verification-record.schema.json`** — the G08 record `badf_gate.py verify` validates: `target`, `change_class`, `lenses_routed[]`, `ballots[]` (each: `ballot_id`, `reviewer`, `principal_type`, `reviewer_run_id`, `sealed_input_digest`, `verdict`, `finding_ids[]`, `non_coverage[]`), `independence` (as above), `findings[]` (the architecture-assurance finding item — `finding_id` `^VF-[0-9]{3,}$`, `kind` extended with `REGRESSION|DEFECT|SECURITY|CONTRACT|DATA|OPERABILITY|CONVENTION|PROMPT_INJECTION`, `severity INFO|MINOR|MAJOR|CRITICAL`, `status OPEN|RESOLVED|ACCEPTED_BY_AUTHORITY|WITHDRAWN` + `lens`, `reported_by[]`, `also_reported_by[]`, `requirement_refs[]`, `evidence_refs[]`), `synthesis {withdrawn[] {finding_id, reason, by}, downgraded[] {finding_id, from, to, decision_ref}}`, `matrix[]` rows (`claim_ref`, `change_ref`, `review_refs[]`, `integration_refs[]`, `contract_refs[]`, `composed_refs[]`, `result VERIFIED|PARTIAL|UNVERIFIED`), `non_coverage[]`, `authority {verification_authority: false}` (mirrors assurance's `implementation_authority: false`). `additionalProperties: false` throughout.
- **`badf_gate.py`:** `check_g08_binding` registered in `EVIDENCE_RULES` for the four types — when `binding` is present: `check_schema(type)`, producer rule, the review non-empty rule, contract result↔outcome consistency, and artifact agreement (composed: `binding.composition.recomputed_content_tree` equals the `tree:` line in the artifact; integration: counts equal the parsed log via the existing `_parse_unittest_log` where the log is unittest-shaped, else `exit_code` equals the artifact's `exit=` line). Generic objects unchanged → `test_badf_g08_verification` (WP-2026-0010) stays green. `validate_verification_record(path)` + `verify` subcommand mirroring `assure`/`solution`/`security`: schema, ballot digest equality with `independence.sealed_input_digest`, no duplicate reviewer, no reviewer == author run, every ballot `finding_id` present in `findings` or in `synthesis.withdrawn` with a reason (VER-I12), every `downgraded` entry carries a `decision_ref`, matrix refs resolve to ballot/finding ids or evidence ids named in the record, VERIFIED rows carry no OPEN finding of severity ≥ MAJOR, `authority.verification_authority == false`. Typed in code, not walker-trusted (#171 precedent).
- Registry `badf-engineering-verification` `DESIGNED → IMPLEMENTED` (SKILL.md untouched, digest unchanged); doctrine section; DEM export; own composition record + typed G07 self-dossier; reconciles WP-2026-0100.
- **No** executor, **no** ledger writer, **no** change to `lifecycle.json`, `badf_compose.py`, the CI workflow, `self_dossier`'s G07 production, or any `badf-build`/`badf-git` file.
